name: Corb
text: Corb, also spelled Corbb, is a god of the Fomorians in Lebor Gabála Érenn, the Book of Invasions. The name may relate to an Irish verb meaning defiles. The record of this deity is brief, and the Book of Invasions is the source that names him among the Fomorian kind.

attributes.attribute: Fomorian god named in Lebor Gabála Érenn
name perhaps from an Irish verb meaning defiles

key_results: Identify Corb or Corbb as a god of the Fomorians.
Give the Book of Invasions as the source that names him.
Note the proposed sense of the name from an Irish verb for defiles.
